body: Source: GitHub issue #1057. In packages/backlog-groom/lib/classify.mjs, parseReferences attributed every fenced block to the nearest preceding path mention without checking whether the fence is source from that file. Require positive evidence that a fence is source for the cited path: reject fences on non-code documentation files (.md/.mdx/.txt), reject language tags that conflict with the file extension, require a line citation (or matching language tag) rather than attributing untagged fences to bare prose path mentions, and reject shell command blocks, Markdown table rows, diff headers, single-line JSON key fragments on non-JSON files, and sub-line fragments with unbalanced closing delimiters.
criteria: parseReferences does not attach shell transcripts, table rows, diff blocks, incompatible language-tagged fences, untagged fences after bare line-less path mentions, or unbalanced sub-line fragments as cited snippets.
Two issues citing the same path with different shell fences do not attach those shell fences as snippets and do not verify fixed.
out_of_scope: Changing subsequence matching or precedence rules in packages/backlog-groom/lib/verify.mjs.
title: backlog-groom: require source-fence evidence before attributing excerpts in classify (#1057)
